opening: I have pain in my flank, along my side.
I've had a fever that won't go away.
The tiredness, side pain and fever have kept going even though the sinusitis got better.
I was first treated with amoxicillin for the sinusitis, for 12 days.
Then my antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week.

opening.text: I've been feeling tired, and I have pain in my flank, along my side. I've also had a fever that won't go away. I had acute sinusitis, which was first treated with amoxicillin for 12 days, and then my antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week. The tiredness, side pain, and fever have kept going even though the sinusitis got better.
